name: Check business hours for an AI receptionist

parameters.content:
## Check business hours for an AI receptionist

Return the current local office status from a configurable weekly schedule, date closures and overnight hours.

Services: n8n.

Setup:
1. Choose a Webhook Header Auth credential and set a unique path.
2. In Configure Office, replace YOUR_TIME_ZONE with an IANA time zone and replace the sample schedule with the actual hours.
3. Add closed dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty days are closed.
4. Send an authenticated POST with an empty JSON object to the test webhook and verify open, closed, overnight and closure cases.

Keep this workflow inactive until configured and tested.
